description: The record of the knowledge layer: representation, ontology, extraction safeguards, retrieval modes, refresh policy and governed metrics, with the forces, alternatives and consequences behind them.
A question the knowledge system must answer. Each one names classes and relations, so together they define the minimal ontology and the traversal depth.
The implementable part of the decision: ontology, extraction safeguards, local and global retrieval, rebuild schedule, projected cost and semantic layer metrics.
The monthly cost of keeping the graph and its summaries current: extraction per changed document plus summary rebuilds.
A metric defined once in the semantic layer with an owner, formula and filters, so dashboards and agents report the same number.
